```rust
//! Server Message Block v2/v3 (SMB2/SMB3, MS-SMB2) Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) definitions.
//!
//! This module defines [`SmbSpec`], the zero-copy AST representation of a Microsoft Server Message
//! Block v2/v3 (`[MS-SMB2]`) packet over TCP port 445 (or NetBIOS Session Service port 139).
//! On the wire, an SMB2 frame begins with a 4-byte NetBIOS stream length prefix followed by a
//! 64-byte SMB2 header (`\xFESMB` magic, StructureSize 64, CreditCharge, NTStatus, Command code,
//! Flags, MessageId, TreeId, SessionId, and 16-byte Signature) and command-specific body structures.
//! Canonical FrameAssembly `.fasm` syntax models SMB2 frames using
//! `smb [command <str>] [status <u32>] [treeid <u32>] [sessionid <u64>] [msgid <u64>] [share <str>] [filename <str>]`.

/// Microsoft Server Message Block v2/v3 (`[MS-SMB2]`) protocol specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `smb [command <str>] [status <u32>] [treeid <u32>] [sessionid <u64>] [msgid <u64>] [share <str>] [filename <str>]`
#[doc(alias = "smb")]
#[doc(alias = "MS-SMB2")]
#[doc(alias = "SMB2")]
#[doc(alias = "SMB3")]
#[doc(alias = "CIFS")]
#[doc(alias = "command")]
#[doc(alias = "status")]
#[doc(alias = "treeid")]
#[doc(alias = "sessionid")]
#[doc(alias = "msgid")]
#[doc(alias = "share")]
#[doc(alias = "filename")]
#[doc(alias = "445")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct SmbSpec<'a> {
    /// SMB2 command name (`command <str>`, e.g., `"NEGOTIATE"`, `"SESSION_SETUP"`, `"TREE_CONNECT"`, `"CREATE"`, `"READ"`, `"WRITE"`).
    pub command: Option<&'a str>,
    /// NTSTATUS 32-bit return code (`status <u32>`, default `0` for `STATUS_SUCCESS`).
    pub status: Option<u32>,
    /// 32-bit SMB2 Tree ID identifying a mounted share (`treeid <u32>`).
    pub tree_id: Option<u32>,
    /// 64-bit SMB2 Session ID identifying an authenticated user session (`sessionid <u64>`).
    pub session_id: Option<u64>,
    /// 64-bit SMB2 Message ID sequence counter (`msgid <u64>`).
    pub msgid: Option<u64>,
    /// UNC share path for `treeconnect` requests (`share <str>`).
    pub share: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Target file or named pipe path for `create` requests (`filename <str>`).
    pub filename: Option<&'a str>,
}

## `src/ast/l7/snmp.rs`

```rust
//! Simple Network Management Protocol v1, v2c, and v3 (SNMP, RFC 1157 / RFC 3416 / RFC 3414) AST definitions.
//!
//! This module defines the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) types for SNMPv1 ([`Snmp1Spec`], RFC 1157),
//! community-based SNMPv2c ([`Snmp2Spec`], RFC 1901 / RFC 3416), and User-Based Security Model
//! SNMPv3 ([`Snmp3Spec`], RFC 3412 / RFC 3414 / RFC 3826 / RFC 7860) over UDP ports 161 (queries)
//! and 162 (traps/informs). On the wire, SNMP messages are ASN.1 BER `SEQUENCE` envelopes carrying
//! version integers (`0`, `1`, `3`), community or USM security parameters (HMAC-MD5/SHA/SHA-2 and
//! DES/AES-128 privacy), a context-tagged PDU (`GetRequest`, `GetNextRequest`, `Response`,
//! `SetRequest`, `Trap`, `GetBulkRequest`, `InformRequest`), and a sequence of [`VarBindAst`] pairs.

use alloc::vec::Vec;
use core::net::IpAddr;

/// Represents the ASN.1 BER PDU type of an SNMPv1, SNMPv2c, or SNMPv3 message.
#[doc(alias = "trap")]
#[doc(alias = "get")]
#[doc(alias = "set")]
#[doc(alias = "response")]
#[doc(alias = "inform")]
#[doc(alias = "getnext")]
#[doc(alias = "getbulk")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SnmpPduType {
    /// SNMPv1 Trap (`0xA4`) or SNMPv2c/v3 Trapv2 (`0xA7`) PDU (`trap`).
    Trap,
    /// SNMP GetRequest (`0xA0`) PDU (`get`).
    Get,
    /// SNMP SetRequest (`0xA3`) PDU (`set`).
    Set,
    /// SNMP GetResponse (`0xA2`) PDU (`response`).
    Response,
    /// SNMPv2c/v3 InformRequest (`0xA6`) PDU (`inform`).
    Inform,
    /// SNMP GetNextRequest (`0xA1`) PDU (`getnext`).
    GetNext,
    /// SNMPv2c/v3 GetBulkRequest (`0xA5`) PDU (`getbulk`).
    GetBulk,
}

/// Represents the SNMPv3 User-Based Security Model (USM) authentication algorithm (RFC 3414 / RFC 7860).
#[doc(alias = "auth")]
#[doc(alias = "md5")]
#[doc(alias = "sha")]
#[doc(alias = "sha256")]
#[doc(alias = "sha384")]
#[doc(alias = "sha512")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SnmpAuthType {
    /// HMAC-MD5-96 authentication (`auth md5 <pass>`, RFC 3414).
    Md5,
    /// HMAC-SHA-96 authentication (`auth sha <pass>`, RFC 3414).
    Sha,
    /// HMAC-SHA-256-128 authentication (`auth sha256 <pass>`, RFC 7860).
    Sha256,
    /// HMAC-SHA-384-192 authentication (`auth sha384 <pass>`, RFC 7860).
    Sha384,
    /// HMAC-SHA-512-256 authentication (`auth sha512 <pass>`, RFC 7860).
    Sha512,
}

/// Represents the SNMPv3 User-Based Security Model (USM) privacy encryption algorithm (RFC 3414 / RFC 3826).
#[doc(alias = "priv")]
#[doc(alias = "des")]
#[doc(alias = "aes")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SnmpPrivType {
    /// CBC-DES 56-bit privacy (`priv des <pass>`, RFC 3414).
    Des,
    /// CFB128-AES-128 privacy (`priv aes <pass>`, RFC 3826).
    Aes,
}

/// Represents the typed SMIv1/SMIv2 value of an SNMP variable binding (`varbind <oid> <type> [val]`).
#[doc(alias = "varbind")]
#[doc(alias = "nullval")]
#[doc(alias = "string")]
#[doc(alias = "int")]
#[doc(alias = "timeticks")]
#[doc(alias = "ipval")]
#[doc(alias = "oidval")]
#[doc(alias = "counter32")]
#[doc(alias = "gauge32")]
#[doc(alias = "counter64")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum VarBindType<'a> {
    /// ASN.1 `null` (`0x05`) value (`nullval`).
    Null,
    /// ASN.1 `OCTET STRING` (`0x04`) value (`string <str>`).
    String(&'a str),
    /// ASN.1 32-bit signed `INTEGER` (`0x02`) value (`int <i32>`).
    Int(i32),
    /// SMI `TimeTicks` (`0x43`) hundredths of a second value (`timeticks <u32>`).
    TimeTicks(u32),
    /// SMI `IpAddress` (`0x40`) or RFC 4001 `InetAddress` value (`ipval <ip>`).
    Ip(IpAddr),
    /// ASN.1 `OBJECT IDENTIFIER` (`0x06`) value (`oidval <oid>`).
    OidVal(&'a str),
    /// SMI `Counter32` (`0x41`) 32-bit wrapping counter (`counter32 <u32>`).
    Counter32(u32),
    /// SMI `Gauge32` (`0x42`) 32-bit non-wrapping gauge (`gauge32 <u32>`).
    Gauge32(u32),
    /// SMIv2 `Counter64` (`0x46`) 64-bit high-capacity counter (`counter64 <u64>`).
    Counter64(u64),
}

/// Represents a single SNMP variable binding (`varbind <oid> <type> [val]`).
///
/// Syntax mapping: `varbind <oid> <nullval | string <str> | int <i32> | timeticks <u32> | ipval <ip> | oidval <oid> | counter32 <u32> | gauge32 <u32> | counter64 <u64>>`
#[doc(alias = "varbind")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct VarBindAst<'a> {
    /// Dotted-decimal Object Identifier string (`<oid>`).
    pub oid: &'a str,
    /// Typed SMI value associated with the OID.
    pub val: VarBindType<'a>,
}

/// RFC 1157 Simple Network Management Protocol Version 1 (SNMPv1) specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `snmp1 [trap | get | getnext | set | response] [community <str>] [enterprise <oid>] [agentip <ip>] [gentrap <u32>] [spectrap <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [reqid <u32>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
#[doc(alias = "snmp1")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 1157")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC1157")]
#[doc(alias = "trap")]
#[doc(alias = "get")]
#[doc(alias = "getnext")]
#[doc(alias = "set")]
#[doc(alias = "response")]
#[doc(alias = "community")]
#[doc(alias = "enterprise")]
#[doc(alias = "agentip")]
#[doc(alias = "gentrap")]
#[doc(alias = "spectrap")]
#[doc(alias = "sysuptime")]
#[doc(alias = "reqid")]
#[doc(alias = "varbind")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct Snmp1Spec<'a> {
    /// Cleartext SNMPv1 community string (`community <str>`, default `"public"`).
    pub community: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Enterprise OID for Trap-PDU (`enterprise <oid>`).
    pub enterprise: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Agent network address override for Trap-PDU (`agentip <ip>`).
    pub agent_ip: Option<IpAddr>,
    /// Generic trap code `0..=6` (`gentrap <u32>`, default `6` for `enterpriseSpecific`).
    pub gen_trap: Option<u32>,
    /// Enterprise-specific trap sub-code (`spectrap <u32>`, default `1`).
    pub spec_trap: Option<u32>,
    /// Agent `sysUpTime` in hundredths of a second (`sysuptime <u32>`).
    pub sys_up_time: Option<u32>,
    /// Ordered list of SMIv1 variable bindings (`varbind <oid> <val>`).
    pub varbinds: Vec<VarBindAst<'a>>,
    /// SNMPv1 PDU operation type (`trap`, `get`, `getnext`, `set`, `response`).
    pub pdu_type: Option<SnmpPduType>,
}

/// RFC 1901 / RFC 3416 Community-Based Simple Network Management Protocol Version 2 (SNMPv2c) specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `snmp2 [trap | inform | get | getnext | getbulk | set | response] [community <str>] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
#[doc(alias = "snmp2")]
#[doc(alias = "SNMPv2c")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 3416")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC3416")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 1901")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC1901")]
#[doc(alias = "trap")]

#[doc(alias = "oid")]
#[doc(alias = "varbind")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct Snmp2Spec<'a> {
    /// Cleartext SNMPv2c community string (`community <str>`, default `"public"`).
    pub community: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Ordered list of SMIv2 variable bindings (`varbind <oid> <val>`).
    pub varbinds: Vec<VarBindAst<'a>>,
    /// SNMPv2c PDU operation type (`trap`, `inform`, `get`, `getnext`, `getbulk`, `set`, `response`).
    pub pdu_type: Option<SnmpPduType>,
    /// `non-repeaters` count for `GetBulkRequest` (`nonrepeaters <u32>`).
    pub non_repeaters: Option<u32>,
    /// `max-repetitions` count for `GetBulkRequest` (`maxrepetitions <u32>`).
    pub max_repetitions: Option<u32>,
    /// 32-bit PDU `request-id` (`reqid <u32>`).
    pub req_id: Option<u32>,
}

/// RFC 3412 / RFC 3414 Simple Network Management Protocol Version 3 (SNMPv3 USM) specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `snmp3 [trap | inform | get | getnext | getbulk | set | response] [user <str>] [engineid <hex>] [engineboots <u32>] [enginetime <u32>] [contextname <str>] [auth <alg> <pass>] [priv <alg> <pass>] [reqid <u32>] [nonrepeaters <u32>] [maxrepetitions <u32>] [sysuptime <u32>] [oid <oid>] [varbind <oid> <val>...]`
#[doc(alias = "snmp3")]
#[doc(alias = "SNMPv3")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 3414")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC3414")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 3412")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 3826")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 7860")]
#[doc(alias = "trap")]
#[doc(alias = "inform")]
#[doc(alias = "get")]
#[doc(alias = "getnext")]

#[doc(alias = "priv")]
#[doc(alias = "reqid")]
#[doc(alias = "nonrepeaters")]
#[doc(alias = "maxrepetitions")]
#[doc(alias = "sysuptime")]
#[doc(alias = "oid")]
#[doc(alias = "varbind")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct Snmp3Spec<'a> {
    /// USM securityName (`user <str>`, default `"admin"`).
    pub user: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Hex-encoded `msgAuthoritativeEngineID` (`engineid <hex>`).
    pub engine_id: Option<&'a str>,
    /// `msgAuthoritativeEngineBoots` counter (`engineboots <u32>`, default `1`).
    pub engine_boots: Option<u32>,
    /// `msgAuthoritativeEngineTime` in seconds (`enginetime <u32>`, default `100`).
    pub engine_time: Option<u32>,
    /// ScopedPDU `contextName` (`contextname <str>`, default `""`).
    pub context_name: Option<&'a str>,
    /// USM authentication algorithm and passphrase (`auth <md5|sha|sha256|sha384|sha512> <pass>`).
    pub auth: Option<(SnmpAuthType, &'a str)>,
    /// USM privacy algorithm and passphrase (`priv <des|aes> <pass>`).
    pub priv_param: Option<(SnmpPrivType, &'a str)>,
    /// Ordered list of SMIv2 variable bindings (`varbind <oid> <val>`).
    pub varbinds: Vec<VarBindAst<'a>>,
    /// SNMPv3 ScopedPDU operation type (`trap`, `inform`, `get`, `getnext`, `getbulk`, `set`, `response`).
    pub pdu_type: Option<SnmpPduType>,
    /// `non-repeaters` count for `GetBulkRequest` (`nonrepeaters <u32>`).
    pub non_repeaters: Option<u32>,
    /// `max-repetitions` count for `GetBulkRequest` (`maxrepetitions <u32>`).
    pub max_repetitions: Option<u32>,
    /// 32-bit PDU `request-id` (`reqid <u32>`).
    pub req_id: Option<u32>,
}

/// Type alias for SNMP variable binding ([`VarBindAst`]).
pub type SnmpVarBind<'a> = VarBindAst<'a>;

/// Type alias for SNMP variable binding value ([`VarBindType`]).
pub type SnmpValue<'a> = VarBindType<'a>;

/// Type alias for SNMP authentication protocol ([`SnmpAuthType`]).
pub type SnmpAuthProtocol = SnmpAuthType;

/// Type alias for SNMP privacy protocol ([`SnmpPrivType`]).
pub type SnmpPrivProtocol = SnmpPrivType;

/// SNMP security model identifier (RFC 3411 / RFC 3414).
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum SnmpSecurityModel {
    /// User-Based Security Model (USM, securityModel 3, RFC 3414).
    Usm,
}

//! Simple Service Discovery Protocol (SSDP / UPnP) (UPnP Device Architecture 1.1 / 2.0 (HTTPU over UDP Multicast)) Layer 7 AST definitions.
//!
//! This module defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) configuration parameters for synthesizing
//! Simple Service Discovery Protocol (SSDP / UPnP) packets over UDP port 1900 (IPv4 multicast 239.255.255.250 / IPv6 ff02::c or ff05::c). On the wire, the protocol uses a HTTP-over-UDP (HTTPU) multicast datagram beginning with `M-SEARCH * http/1.1\r\n` active discovery request or `notify * http/1.1\r\n` presence advertisement, carrying `host:`, `man:` (`"ssdp:discover"`), `mx:` delay seconds, `st:` Search Target, `nt:` Notification Type, `nts:` (`ssdp:alive`, `ssdp:byebye`, `ssdp:update`), `usn:` Unique Service Name, and `location:` XML device descriptor URL.

//! frames or override specific protocol header fields and attributes.
//!
//! Canonical `.fasm` syntax:
//! `a -> b ssdp [msearch | notify] [hosthdr <str>] [man <str>] [mx <u8>] [st <str>] [nt <str>] [nts <str>] [usn <str>] [location <str>]`

/// Simple Service Discovery Protocol specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `ssdp [msearch | notify] [hosthdr <str>] [man <str>] [mx <u8>] [st <str>] [nt <str>] [nts <str>] [usn <str>] [location <str>]`

#[doc(alias = "nt")]
#[doc(alias = "nts")]
#[doc(alias = "usn")]
#[doc(alias = "location")]
#[doc(alias = "1900")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct SsdpSpec<'a> {
    /// M-SEARCH discovery flag.
    pub is_msearch: bool,
    /// NOTIFY advertisement flag.
    pub is_notify: bool,

//! This module defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) configuration parameters for synthesizing

On the wire, the protocol uses a 7-bit/8-bit NVT-ASCII stream interspersed with 3-byte Interpret As Command (`IAC = 0xFF`) option negotiation sequences: `IAC will <opt>` (`0xFF 0xFB <opt>`), `IAC wont <opt>` (`0xFF 0xFC <opt>`), `IAC do <opt>` (`0xFF 0xFD <opt>`), `IAC dont <opt>` (`0xFF 0xFE <opt>`), and `IAC SB <opt> ... #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]

```rust
//! Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3) (RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) / RFC 5246 (TLS 1.2) / RFC 6066 (SNI) / RFC 7301 (ALPN)) Layer 7 AST definitions.
//!
//! This module defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) configuration parameters for synthesizing
//! Transport Layer Security (TLS 1.2 / TLS 1.3) packets over TCP port 443. On the wire, the protocol uses a 5-byte TLS Record Layer header (8-bit ContentType: `21` Alert, `22` Handshake, `23` ApplicationData; 16-bit Legacy Record Version e.g. `0x0303`; 16-bit Length) encapsulating a 4-byte Handshake header (8-bit HandshakeType: `1` ClientHello, `2` ServerHello, `11` Certificate, `20` Finished; 24-bit Length), 32-byte Random nonce, CipherSuite list (`0x1301` TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256, `0x1302` TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384), and SNI (`0x0000`) / ALPN (`0x0010`) extensions.

//! frames or override specific protocol header fields and attributes.

//! Canonical `.fasm` syntax:
//! `a -> b tls [clienthello | serverhello | certificate | finished | appdata | alert] [recordversion <u16>] [handshakeversion <u16>] [sni <str>] [ciphersuite <u16>] [alpn <str>]`

/// RFC 8446 Transport Layer Security specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `tls [clienthello | serverhello | certificate | finished | appdata | alert] [recordversion <u16>] [handshakeversion <u16>] [sni <str>] [ciphersuite <u16>] [alpn <str>]`
#[doc(alias = "tls")]

#[doc(alias = "RFC8446")]

#[doc(alias = "clienthello")]
#[doc(alias = "serverhello")]
#[doc(alias = "certificate")]
#[doc(alias = "finished")]
#[doc(alias = "appdata")]
#[doc(alias = "alert")]
#[doc(alias = "recordversion")]
#[doc(alias = "handshakeversion")]
#[doc(alias = "sni")]
#[doc(alias = "alpn")]
#[doc(alias = "ciphersuite")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct TlsSpec<'a> {
    /// ClientHello handshake flag.
    pub is_client_hello: bool,
    /// ServerHello handshake flag.
    pub is_server_hello: bool,
    /// Certificate handshake flag.
    pub is_certificate: bool,
    /// Finished handshake flag.
    pub is_finished: bool,
    /// ApplicationData record flag.
    pub is_app_data: bool,
    /// Alert record flag.
    pub is_alert: bool,
    /// Record layer version.
    pub record_version: Option<u16>,
    /// Handshake protocol version.
    pub handshake_version: Option<u16>,
    /// Server Name Indication hostname.
    pub sni: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Cipher suite identifier.
    pub ciphersuite: Option<u16>,
    /// Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation string.
    pub alpn: Option<&'a str>,
}
```

## `src/ast/l7/websocket.rs`

```rust
//! The WebSocket Protocol (RFC 6455) Layer 7 AST definitions.
//!
//! This module defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) configuration parameters for synthesizing
//! The WebSocket Protocol packets over TCP port 80 (`ws://`) or TCP port 443 (`wss://`). On the wire, the protocol uses a 2-to-14-byte RFC 6455 binary frame header: Byte 0 packs 1-bit `fin` flag, 3-bit `RSV1..3` extension bits, and 4-bit `Opcode` (`0x1` TEXT, `0x2` BINARY, `0x8` CLOSE, `0x9` PING, `0xA` PONG); Byte 1 packs 1-bit `MASK` flag and 7-bit Payload Length (with optional 16-bit or 64-bit extended length), followed by an optional 32-bit XOR `Masking-Key` and masked/unmasked application payload.
//! Every field in [`WebsocketSpec`] is optional so authors can emit zero-configuration default
//! frames or override specific protocol header fields and attributes.
//!
//! Canonical `.fasm` syntax:
//! `a -> b websocket [opcode <str>] [finbit <u8>] [maskkey <u32>] [payload <str>]`

/// RFC 6455 The WebSocket Protocol specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `websocket [opcode <str>] [finbit <u8>] [maskkey <u32>] [payload <str>]`
#[doc(alias = "websocket")]
#[doc(alias = "WS")]
#[doc(alias = "WSS")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 6455")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC6455")]
#[doc(alias = "opcode")]
#[doc(alias = "finbit")]
#[doc(alias = "maskkey")]
#[doc(alias = "payload")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct WebsocketSpec<'a> {
    /// Opcode name (e.g. TEXT, BINARY, PING, PONG, CLOSE).
    pub opcode: Option<&'a str>,
    /// FIN bit (0 or 1).
    pub fin_bit: Option<u8>,
    /// 32-bit masking key.
    pub mask_key: Option<u32>,
    /// Text payload string.
    pub payload: Option<&'a str>,
}
```

## `src/ast/l7/whois.rs`

```rust
//! WHOIS Domain and IP Registry Query Protocol (RFC 3912) Layer 7 AST definitions.
//!
//! This module defines the abstract syntax tree (AST) configuration parameters for synthesizing
//! WHOIS Domain and IP Registry Query Protocol packets over TCP port 43. On the wire, the protocol uses a Cleartext TCP query-response transaction on port 43 where the client transmits a CRLF-terminated domain name, Autonomous System Number (ASN), or IPv4/IPv6 CIDR prefix query (`<domain>\r\n`) and the RIR/TLD registry server returns human-readable key-value lines (`Domain Name:`, `Registrar:`, `Updated Date:`) before closing the connection.
//! Every field in [`WhoisSpec`] is optional so authors can emit zero-configuration default
//! frames or override specific protocol header fields and attributes.
//!
//! Canonical `.fasm` syntax:
//! `a -> b whois [query | response] [domain <str>] [registrar <str>]`

/// RFC 3912 WHOIS Protocol specification.
///
/// Syntax mapping: `whois [query | response] [domain <str>] [registrar <str>]`
#[doc(alias = "whois")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC 3912")]
#[doc(alias = "RFC3912")]
#[doc(alias = "query")]
#[doc(alias = "response")]
#[doc(alias = "domain")]
#[doc(alias = "registrar")]
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
pub struct WhoisSpec<'a> {
    /// Query flag.
    pub is_query: bool,
    /// Response flag.
    pub is_response: bool,
    /// Domain query string.
    pub domain: Option<&'a str>,
    /// Registrar description string.
    pub registrar: Option<&'a str>,
}
```

# Representative `.fasm` Corpus Scenarios (`examples/`)

## `contrib/linguist/samples/enterprise_snmpv3_and_tls.fasm`

```frameassembly
// FrameAssembly (.fasm) Sample 1: Enterprise Dual-Stack TLS 1.3, HTTP/1.1 & Encrypted SNMPv3 USM
// Media Type: text/vnd.frameassembly
// Specification: https://github.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/blob/main/docs/fasm-specification.md

host branch_client_v4 { ip 10.40.10.15 mac 00:1a:2b:40:10:0f }
host app_gateway_v4   { ip 10.40.10.80 mac 00:1a:2b:40:10:50 }
host branch_client_v6 { ip 2001:db8:40:10::15 mac 00-1A-2B-40-60-0F }
host app_gateway_v6   { ip 2001:db8:40:10::80 mac 001a.2b40.6050 }
host nms_receiver     { ip 10.40.99.200 mac 00:50:56:99:00:c8 }

// Dual-stack TCP 3-way handshake, TLS 1.3 negotiation, and HTTP health check
flow enterprise_web_transaction(client, gateway) {
    client -> gateway vlan 140 pcp 3 dscp 26 tcp syn srcport 53100 dstport 443 win 65535 mss 1460 sackperm wait 1ms
    client <- gateway vlan 140 pcp 3 dscp 26 tcp syn ack win 65535 mss 1460 sackperm wait 1ms
    client -> gateway vlan 140 pcp 3 dscp 26 tcp ack wait 1ms
    client -> gateway vlan 140 pcp 3 dscp 26 tls clienthello sni "portal.corp.example.com" ciphersuite 4865 alpn "h2" wait 3ms
    client <- gateway vlan 140 pcp 3 dscp 26 tls serverhello ciphersuite 4865 alpn "h2" wait 2ms
    client -> gateway vlan 140 http get uri "/api/v1/health" hosthdr "portal.corp.example.com" wait 4ms
    client <- gateway vlan 140 http status 200 reason "OK" contenttype "application/json" body "{\"ok\":true}" wait 2ms
}

// RFC 3414 / 3826 / 7860 SNMPv3 USM authPriv (HMAC-SHA256 + AES-128) trap notification
flow snmpv3_security_alert(gateway, nms) {
    gateway -> nms vlan 99 dscp 48 snmp3 trap user "noc_secops" engineid "80001f888010401050" engineboots 12 enginetime 86400 auth sha256 "NocAuthPass2026!" priv aes "NocPrivPass2026!" reqid 4001 oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.4 varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "app-gw-01.corp" varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.8.1 int 1 wait 5ms
}

compile {
    enterprise_web_transaction(branch_client_v4, app_gateway_v4)
    enterprise_web_transaction(branch_client_v6, app_gateway_v6)
    snmpv3_security_alert(app_gateway_v4, nms_receiver)
}
```

## `contrib/linguist/samples/industrial_ot_modbus_dnp3.fasm`

```frameassembly
// FrameAssembly (.fasm) Sample 2: Industrial OT / SCADA Conduit Verification (Modbus, DNP3, S7comm, OPC UA)
// Media Type: text/vnd.frameassembly
// Specification: https://github.com/SteveWinschel/FrameAssembly/blob/main/docs/fasm-specification.md

host scada_hmi      { ip 192.168.110.10 mac 00:1b:21:b0:00:10 }
host substation_plc { ip 192.168.110.50 mac 00:0e:8c:b0:00:50 }

// Purdue Level 2 HMI to Level 1 PLC polling across 802.1ad QinQ and MPLS transport
flow industrial_conduit_audit(hmi, plc) {
    // Explicit TCP 3-way handshake on Modbus TCP port 502
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 5 dscp 46 tcp syn srcport 54502 dstport 502 win 64240 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 5 dscp 46 tcp syn ack win 64240 mss 1460 wait 1ms
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 5 dscp 46 tcp ack wait 1ms

    // Modbus TCP Function 0x03 (Read Holding Registers) request and response
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 pcp 5 dscp 46 modbus readholdingregisters txid 101 unitid 1 addr 40001 count 4 wait 3ms
    hmi <- plc vlan 110 pcp 5 dscp 46 modbus readholdingregisters txid 101 unitid 1 count 4 value 1500 isresponse wait 3ms

    // IEEE 1815 DNP3 Class 0 integrity poll with automatic CRC-16 calculation
    hmi -> plc qinq 2100 innervlan 110 mpls 24000 exp 5 bos 1 mplsttl 64 dnp3 read src 1 dst 10 seq 1 group 60 variation 1 wait 4ms

    // Siemens S7comm communication setup and OPC UA Binary Hello handshake
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 s7comm setupcomm rosctr "job" pduref 201 wait 2ms
    hmi -> plc vlan 110 opcua msgtype "hel" chunktype "f" endpointurl "opc.tcp://192.168.110.50:4840" wait 2ms
}

compile {
    industrial_conduit_audit(scada_hmi, substation_plc)
}
```

## `examples/topologies/complete_dsl_omnibus_reference.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: Omnibus reference script exercising 100% of all FrameAssembly DSL lexical tokens, protocols, TCP flags, SNMP versions, PDU types, and USM auth/priv algorithms.
// TOKENS: host, ip, mac, flow, tcp, syn, ece, cwr, srcport, dstport, seq, acknum, win, payload, wait, ms, ack, s, psh, urg, fin, rst, m, udp, snmp1, trap, community, oid, enterprise, agentip, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define omnibus host alpha with IP 10.254.0.1 and MAC 00:11:22:33:44:01.
host omni_alpha { ip 10.254.0.1 mac 00:11:22:33:44:01 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define omnibus host beta with IP 10.254.0.2 and default MAC.
host omni_beta { ip 10.254.0.2 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define a flow exercising TCP with all 8 flags, explicit SEQ/ACKNUM/WIN/PORTS, PAYLOAD, and WAIT suffixes ms, s, and m.
flow omnibus_tcp_udp(a, b) {
    a -> b tcp syn ece cwr srcport 50000 dstport 443 seq 1000 acknum 0 win 65535 payload "SYN_INIT"
        wait 5ms
    a <- b tcp syn ack ece srcport 443 dstport 50000 seq 2000 acknum 1009 win 32768 payload "SYN_ACK"
        wait 1s
    a -> b tcp psh urg ack fin rst srcport 50000 dstport 443 seq 1009 acknum 2008 win 16384 payload "OMNI_TCP"
        wait 1m
    a -> b udp srcport 53000 dstport 53 payload "OMNI_UDP_QUERY" wait 10ms
    a <- b udp srcport 53 dstport 53000 payload "OMNI_UDP_REPLY" wait 10ms
}

// INSTRUCTION: Define a flow exercising SNMP1, SNMP2, and SNMP3 across all 7 PDU types, all 9 VarBind types, and all 5 AUTH and 2 PRIV algorithms.
flow omnibus_snmp(agent, nms) {
    agent -> nms snmp1 trap community "public" oid 1.3.6.1.4.1.8072
        enterprise 1.3.6.1.4.1.8072 agentip 10.254.0.1 gentrap 6 spectrap 1
        sysuptime 100
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "omni"
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.1.0 int -5
    agent -> nms snmp2 get community "public" reqid 101
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0 nullval
    agent <- nms snmp2 response community "public" reqid 101
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0 timeticks 500
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.4.20.1.1.10.254.0.1 ipval 10.254.0.1
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.2.0 oidval 1.3.6.1.4.1.8072
    agent -> nms snmp2 getnext community "public" reqid 102
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1 nullval
    agent -> nms snmp2 getbulk community "public" reqid 103 nonrepeaters 1
        maxrepetitions 5
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.10.1 counter32 100
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.2.2.1.5.1 gauge32 1000
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.31.1.1.1.6.1 counter64 999999999
    agent -> nms snmp2 set community "private" reqid 104
        varbind 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5.0 string "set-omni"
    agent -> nms snmp2 inform community "public" reqid 105 oid "1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3"
        sysuptime 200
    agent -> nms snmp3 trap user "u1" engineid "8000000001" engineboots 1 enginetime 10 contextname "ctx"
        auth md5 "pass_md5_123" priv des "priv_des_123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.1
    agent -> nms snmp3 trap user "u2" engineid "8000000002" engineboots 1 enginetime 20
        auth sha "pass_sha_123" priv aes "priv_aes_123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.2
    agent -> nms snmp3 trap user "u3" engineid "8000000003" engineboots 1 enginetime 30
        auth sha256 "pass_256_123" priv aes "priv_aes_123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.3
    agent -> nms snmp3 trap user "u4" engineid "8000000004" engineboots 1 enginetime 40
        auth sha384 "pass_384_123" priv des "priv_des_123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.4
    agent -> nms snmp3 trap user "u5" engineid "8000000005" engineboots 1 enginetime 50
        auth sha512 "pass_512_123" priv aes "priv_aes_123" oid 1.3.6.1.6.3.1.1.5.5
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile block executing both omnibus flows directly and across repeated cycles.
compile {
    omnibus_tcp_udp(omni_alpha, omni_beta)
    omnibus_snmp(omni_alpha, omni_beta) // cycle 1
    omnibus_snmp(omni_alpha, omni_beta) // cycle 2
}
```

## `examples/topologies/dual_stack_polymorphic_flow_basic.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: Basic polymorphic FLOW execution reusing the same flow template across both IPv4 and IPv6 endpoint pairs.
// TOKENS: host, ip, flow, src, dst, tcp, syn, srcport, dstport, ack, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define IPv4 endpoint A.
host node_v4_a { ip 192.168.1.1 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define IPv4 endpoint B.
host node_v4_b { ip 192.168.1.2 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define IPv6 endpoint A.
host node_v6_a { ip 2001:db8:1::1 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define IPv6 endpoint B.
host node_v6_b { ip 2001:db8:1::2 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define polymorphic TCP 3-way handshake flow.
flow generic_handshake(src, dst) {
    src -> dst tcp syn srcport 40000 dstport 8080
    src <- dst tcp syn ack
    src -> dst tcp ack
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile block executing polymorphic flow on both IPv4 and IPv6 pairs.
compile {
    generic_handshake(node_v4_a, node_v4_b)
    generic_handshake(node_v6_a, node_v6_b)
}
```

## `examples/l2/arp/arp_address_conflict_detection_probe.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: RFC 5227 IPv4 Address Conflict Detection (ACD) ARP probe with zero sender IP and subsequent announcement.
// TOKENS: host, ip, mac, flow, arp, request, sendermac, senderip, targetmac, targetip, wait, s, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define newly booting DHCP client probing tentative IPv4 address.
host acd_prober {
    ip 192.168.42.77
    mac 08:00:27:a1:b2:c3
}

// INSTRUCTION: Define local broadcast segment peer receiving ACD probes.
host lan_listener {
    ip 192.168.42.1
    mac 00:1c:73:00:00:99
}

// INSTRUCTION: Define RFC 5227 ARP probe with 0.0.0.0 SPA followed by ARP announcement.
flow acd_probe_and_announce(prober, segment) {
    prober -> segment arp request sendermac 08:00:27:a1:b2:c3 senderip 0.0.0.0 targetmac 00:00:00:00:00:00 targetip 192.168.42.77
    prober -> segment arp request sendermac 08:00:27:a1:b2:c3 senderip 0.0.0.0 targetmac 00:00:00:00:00:00 targetip 192.168.42.77 wait 1s
    prober -> segment arp request sendermac 08:00:27:a1:b2:c3 senderip 192.168.42.77 targetmac 00:00:00:00:00:00 targetip 192.168.42.77 wait 2s
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile block executing IPv4 Address Conflict Detection sequence.
compile {
    acd_probe_and_announce(acd_prober, lan_listener)
}
```

## `examples/l3/ikev2/ikev2_child_sa_rekey_with_spis.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: IKEv2 CREATE_CHILD_SA exchange with explicit Initiator/Responder SPIs and Next Payload 46 (SK).
// TOKENS: host, ip, flow, ikev2, createchildsa, initiatorspi, responderspi, msgid, flags, nextpayload, wait, ms, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define site A IKEv2 daemon initiating rekey.
host rekey_ike_a { ip 172.16.101.1 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define site B IKEv2 daemon completing rekey.
host rekey_ike_b { ip 172.16.101.2 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define encrypted CREATE_CHILD_SA exchange with Next Payload 46 (Encrypted and Authenticated).
flow ikev2_rekey_sk(a, b) {
    a -> b ikev2 createchildsa initiatorspi 300400500 responderspi 600700800 msgid 4 flags 8 nextpayload 46
    a <- b ikev2 createchildsa initiatorspi 300400500 responderspi 600700800 msgid 4 flags 32 nextpayload 46 wait 15ms
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile the IKEv2 Child SA rekey flow.
compile {
    ikev2_rekey_sk(rekey_ike_a, rekey_ike_b)
}
```

## `examples/l4/sctp/sctp_5g_n2_handover_preparation_multi_stream.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: 5G gNodeB to AMF N2 Handover Required and Handover Request Ack multiplexed over dedicated SCTP Stream 4 (PPID 60).
// TOKENS: host, ip, mac, flow, dscp, sctp, chunk, data, vtag, stream, ssn, ppid, srcport, dstport, payload, wait, ms, sack, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define source 5G gNodeB initiating inter-gNodeB N2 handover.
host src_gnb_n2 {
    ip 172.22.38.10
    mac 00:25:90:16:26:0a
}

// INSTRUCTION: Define 5G Core AMF coordinating target gNodeB resource allocation.
host core_amf_n2 {
    ip 172.22.38.1
    mac 00:1c:73:16:26:01
}

// INSTRUCTION: Transmit NGAP Handover Required on Stream 4 SSN 0 (PPID 60) and receive Handover Command.
flow sctp_n2_handover(gnb, amf) {
    gnb -> amf dscp 46 sctp chunk data vtag 900384 stream 4 ssn 0 ppid 60 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 payload "ngap_handover_required_target_gnb_008" wait 2ms
    gnb <- amf dscp 46 sctp chunk sack vtag 900384 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 wait 5ms
    gnb <- amf dscp 46 sctp chunk data vtag 900384 stream 4 ssn 0 ppid 60 srcport 38412 dstport 38412 payload "ngap_handover_command_pdu_session_tunnels" wait 2ms
    gnb -> amf dscp 46 sctp chunk sack vtag 900384 srcport 38412 dstport 38412
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile the 5G N2 inter-gNodeB handover SCTP trace.
compile {
    sctp_n2_handover(src_gnb_n2, core_amf_n2)
}
```

## `examples/l7/modbus/industrial_modbus_tcp_udp.fasm`

```frameassembly
// PROMPT: Industrial automation control using Modbus TCP holding register reading and writing on port 502.
// TOKENS: host, ip, flow, m, s, modbus, func, readholdingregisters, addr, count, writesingleregister, value, compile

// INSTRUCTION: Define SCADA master control station.
host scada_master { ip 192.168.1.100 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define PLC slave device.
host plc_slave { ip 192.168.1.200 }

// INSTRUCTION: Define Modbus register read and write operations flow.
flow modbus_flow(m, s) {
    m -> s modbus func readholdingregisters addr 100 count 10
    m -> s modbus func writesingleregister addr 105 value 42
}

// INSTRUCTION: Compile block executing Modbus operations.
compile {
    modbus_flow(scada_master, plc_slave)
}
```
